office_countries: 55 countries (BRSR: 185 international offices) / 56 countries (Integrated Report: 194 service delivery centers)
notes: FY-end figures, read directly: 584,519 permanent employees at 2026-03-31 from 149 nationalities (https://www.ar.tcs.com/integrated-reporting-framework/human-capital/). The BRSR also lists 32,918 'other than permanent' staff, for a total of 617,437. Integrated Report 'About TCS': 'over 580,000 consultants spread across 56 countries and 194 service delivery centers' (https://www.ar.tcs.com/introduction/about-tcs/). The BRSR gives 55 countries and 185 international offices; its entity scope may differ from the group-level Integrated Report. The North America figure is from March 2025 and is a floor ('exceeds'); the release names US bases in New York, Edison NJ, Cincinnati, Santa Clara, Phoenix and Austin. Q1 FY27: net +9,279, LTM IT-services attrition 13.6%, 148 nationalities, women 35%. No country-level (US/India/China) headcount disclosed.
verification: tcs.com returned 403 to direct fetch. The 593,798 figure (2026-06-30) came from a search index of the tcs.com release and matches news coverage (e.g. zeebiz.com). Every FY2026 figure and the North America figure were read directly.

fiscal_year: Ends last Saturday of September (FY2025 ended 2025-09-27; FY2026 10-K due ~late Oct 2026)
notes: Apple does not report headcount quarterly. Stale official figures were excluded: apple.com/job-creation cites 80,000 US employees as of 2016-12-31, and apple.com.cn/job-creation cites 10,000 China employees (page updated March 2018). The 10-K gives no office-country count. Reportable segments are Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific. Manufacturing is done by outsourcing partners 'primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam'; these are not Apple employees.

The official Q1 FY27 press release (read directly) says: 'home to more than 223,000 people across 60 countries'. Its dateline is 'NEW YORK and NOIDA, India, July 13, 2026'. Search results and news put the figure at 223,889, down 3,292 QoQ from 227,181 at 2026-03-31, but the FY-end figure was not read in a primary document. No country-level headcount disclosed in documents reachable.
verification: hcltech.com and nseindia.com timed out on every fetch. The exact 223,889 came from a search index of the investor-release PDF and matches news (peoplematters.in). The '>223,000 / 60 countries' wording was read directly in the official release.
